# Revenue Leak Casebook — Daniel Deepak (Danny)

> Before I spend a rupee, I find where the last one leaked. Revenue-growth consultant, Bengaluru, India. Each case follows: context → problem → evidence → diagnosis → action → outcome → limitations → next step. Figures are labelled Measured, Calculated, Estimate or Data unavailable.

## Cases

- [TONI&GUY Bangalore](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/toni-and-guy.html): Salon, Bengaluru, India. Role: Growth consultant: Google, Meta, GBP, web, reporting, booking app. Period: 28 Feb – 16 Sep 2026. Status: Closed. Evidence grade A (Ad exports joined to point-of-sale revenue by salon). Leak: Leads hit record volume while ticket size fell and no callback loop existed. Headline: +14.7% salon revenue, Mar–Aug 2026 vs same six months of 2025 (₹16.10 Cr vs ₹14.04 Cr).
- [MR Jewels](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/mr-jewels.html): Jewellery e-commerce, Bengaluru, India (ships nationally). Role: Google Ads lead + business review across Shopify, Meta and Google. Period: 1 Aug – 3 Sep 2026. Status: Closed. Evidence grade A (Google exports reconciled to Shopify orders and billing). Leak: Google claimed 11.8× the company's monthly revenue; the real losses sat in the cart and in returns. Headline: −66% showroom campaign CPC after one conversion-goal fix (₹38.60 → ₹13.13).
- [Elites Dental Care](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/elites-dental.html): Dental clinic, Bengaluru, India. Role: Audit, Business Profile rebuild, Search campaign rebuild. Period: Audit 18 Sep 2026 · rebuild from 27 Sep. Status: Active. Evidence grade B (Google Ads, GA4, Search Console and GBP data; no clinic revenue yet). Leak: ₹3,140 per booking: the clicks were fine, everything after the click was broken. Headline: ₹3,140 cost per booking before the rebuild (₹25,122 for 8 bookings).
- [Resort & events venue](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/resort.html): Hospitality, Electronic City, Bengaluru. Role: Revenue audit, Business Profile management. Period: Audit 25–26 Sep 2026 · Business Profile work from 28 Sep. Status: Active. Evidence grade D (Outside-in audit plus Business Profile performance data; no ad or booking data yet). Leak: Guests want to buy; the journey ends at 'Enquire' while the same room sells 55% cheaper on an OTA. Headline: −55% room price on an OTA via Google Hotels vs the resort's own site (₹1,780 vs ₹3,999).
- [Foremost Public Adjusters](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/foremost-pa.html): Insurance claims (public adjuster), South Florida, USA. Role: Paid search audit, SEO fixes, campaign build, brand investigation. Period: Jan – Jul 2026. Status: Closed. Evidence grade B (Google Ads and Search Console exports; no claim or fee data). Leak: Lead cost swung on post-click conversion, not budget, and the firm had stopped appearing for its own name. Headline: 0 / 247 live keywords that were branded: the brand campaign had been paused in a restructure.
- [EveryWatch](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/everywatch.html): Luxury-watch marketplace, Global (remote). Role: Growth & performance lead (in-house). Period: 2024 – 2025. Status: In-house role. Evidence grade C (Monthly series reconstructed in an earlier case study; raw exports not in the repo). Leak: Acquisition scaled; returning users stayed near one in ten. Headline: 20× monthly new users, Jan 2024 (9,113) to May 2025 (182,782), GA4.
- [Swift Restoration](https://dannygrowthmarketing.github.io/revenue-casebook/swift-restoration.html): Emergency restoration, Central Iowa, USA. Role: Audit and execution plan. Period: Jun 2026. Status: Diagnostic. Evidence grade D (Site crawl, Ahrefs, SERP and ad checks; no lead or revenue data). Leak: A 5.0★ operator with no service pages, no location pages and no Local Services Ads. Headline: 0 service or location pages on the site at audit (service cards linked to '#').
